info.title: Find a Tender & Contracts Finder: UK government tenders
info.description:
Which UK government tenders were published today? Returns Find a Tender and Contracts Finder notices with buyer, value, deadline and source link.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper
Author: Public Records.
